thread.title_full: Sean "Diddy" Combs Sells His Private Jet for an Estimated $30M

author: Nina Deleon
title: Sean "Diddy" Combs Sells His Private Jet for an Estimated $30M
text:
Nationwide — Sean “Diddy” Combs has sold his matte black private jet just six months after being convicted on two federal prostitution-related charges. The move signals a major shift for the 56-year-old music mogul as he prepares to face prison and a $500,000 fine.
The Gulfstream G550, previously owned by Combs’ LoveAir LLC, changed hands in October 2025. FAA records show the jet, once registered as N1969C, now carries the San Marino tail number T7-OKS. Silver Air Private Jets, which had managed the aircraft, confirmed their services ended after the sale, according to People.
Built in 2015, the jet seats up to 14 passengers, features a pet-friendly beige interior, and comes with a full entertainment system. Its matte black exterior was a signature look, often captured in photos of Combs boarding before his arrest.
While the exact sale price hasn’t been revealed, similar Gulfstream G550 models range from $15 million to $30 million.
Combs’ plane was part of high-profile movements leading up to his legal troubles. In March 2024, it flew from California to Antigua amid federal raids on his Los Angeles and Miami homes.
Later, Combs shared a video on Instagram showing himself boarding the jet, greeting flight staff with a “Combs Air” placemat at the bottom of the steps, and saying, “No place like home.”
In July 2025, Combs was sentenced to 50 months in prison for his prostitution-related convictions. With credit for time served, he is expected to spend roughly three years behind bars, followed by five years of supervised release and a $500,000 fine.
